view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view (XY plane) and a FRONT view (XZ plane). The X-axis represents width (horizontal in TOP), the Y-axis represents depth (vertical in TOP), and the Z-axis represents height/thickness (vertical in FRONT). The part is a flat plate lying in the XY plane with thickness along Z.

features.placement: Base profile in XY plane from Z=0 to Z=6. The outline is defined by the rectangle [0,0] to [60,40] with modifications: Top-Right corner rounded with R6 (center at [54, 34]). A notch is cut from the top edge (Y=40), centered on X=30, extending from X=20 to X=40 and Y=30 to Y=40.
features.evidence: TOP view shows the outline with dimensions 60 (width) and 40 (height). Text notes specify 'Top-right corner R6 only', 'Notch: 20 wide x 10 deep', and 'Notch centred on top edge'. FRONT view shows '6 thick' and notes 'Same outline through full thickness'.

features.placement: Circular hole centered at X=12, Y=15. Extends through the full thickness Z=0 to Z=6.
features.evidence: TOP view shows a circle labeled 'Ø8 THROUGH'. Text notes specify 'Hole centre: 12 from left edge, 15 from bottom edge'.

connections: The through_hole is subtracted from the plate_body.
The notch and rounded corner are part of the plate_body profile definition.
edit_rules: Changing the plate thickness (Z) updates the extrusion height but preserves the XY profile.
Changing the notch width or depth updates the XY profile vertices.
Changing the hole diameter or position updates the subtractive cylinder parameters.
Changing the corner radius updates the arc definition in the XY profile.
